rca of the issue: Fixed bug: navigator.clipboard.writeText in sandboxed preview iframes throws NotAllowedError. The original one-liner discarded the returned Promise, producing 'Uncaught (in promise) NotAllowedError' which the CRA dev overlay rendered as a full-page error, intercepting subsequent Playwright clicks. Fix: await inside try/catch, on failure fall back to a temporary textarea + document.execCommand('copy'). Reproduction: log in, open any unpaid invoice detail, click Copier — no overlay appears now, toast 'Référence copiée' shown.
